reasons.image:
nokia/cmglinux/Makefile: standard IMG_REPOSITORY convention (VENDOR=Nokia,
NAME=cmglinux -> "nokia_cmglinux"), NOT the README prose's inconsistent
"vrnetlab/cmglinux" / "vrnetlab/vr-cmglinux" (the README contradicts itself
between its two mentions - the Makefile is the actual executable source of
truth and was trusted over the prose per rule #33's spirit). Version
"24.3.R1" matches both the Makefile's VERSION-extraction regex example and
the README's own worked example ("cmg-linux-24.3.R1.qcow2").
reasons.min_ram_mb:
README "Host requirements": 4 vCPU, 6 GB RAM. NOT a router/switch/firewall -
CMG Linux is a DB/control VM component of Nokia's MAG-C mobile-core platform,
boots via cloud-init (not a CLI day-0 flow), console is a real Linux login
(user "clab", vrnetlab-injected password) once cloud-init completes.

settings.description: Nokia CMG Linux via vrnetlab (containerized QEMU wrapper) - a DB/control-plane VM component of Nokia's MAG-C platform, not a router/switch. No native netplex profile of any kind exists.
